newsitem.title: USA: NGC buys Canadian crude oil marketing firm.
newsitem.headline: NGC buys Canadian crude oil marketing firm.

text.p: NGC Corp on Thursday said its Canadian unit purchased Calgary-based Wilmar Energy Marketing Co in a deal that expands NGC's North American crude oil operations.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Wilmar, which will operate as NGC Oil Trading and Transportation-Canada, markets about 20,000 barrels per day of crude oil in Canada and NGC markets about 100,000 barrels per day in the United States, the Houston company said.

"This acquisition grows our crude oil business in Canada at a time when the pipeline infrastructure to deliver Canadian crude oil to North American markets is expanding," said Wayne Bartel, vice president of NGC Oil Trading and Transportation.
